content: AUTOSAR system does not need to explicitly describe in- frastructure errors As the fixed set of infrastructure errors is defined as an implicit part of the VFB, a developer of an AUTOSAR system does not need to explicitly de- scribe these. It is assumed that these might occur at run-time and application developers should take measures to handle them.
